episodes.title: When Love Turns Toxic: Carrie, Berger & Cults with Bethany Joy Lenz... (S6 E5 "Lights, Camera, Relationship)
episodes.description: Bethany Joy Lenz joins Kristin and they unpack Carrie and Berger's disastrous motorcycle date. The conversation takes a deeper turn when Joy opens up about spending 10 years in a cult and shares the red flags everyone should know, from love bombing to being cut off from outside perspectives.
